claim: MAJOR FINDING: On v3 detecting-insults-in-social-commentary, even sonnet on ALL 9 roles ($6.83 total) produces an invalid submission (missing 'Comment' column). The schema gate is NOT crossable with any combination of haiku and sonnet — it requires opus. The only routing that has produced a valid submission on this task to date is Phase 1 opus-everywhere ($341.83, gold medal). All four single-role-lift experiments (X202/X209/X217/X218) and now sonnet-everywhere (X219) fail identically. This collapses the routing hypothesis space for detecting-insults: any cost-savings strategy must keep opus on enough roles to satisfy the schema gate, which is currently unknown but at minimum requires opus somewhere central to schema generation.

support.grader_error: Submission should have an Comment column
support.splitter_did_not_fail: Note: Phase 1 sonnet-detecting failed at splitter verifier (v3 splitter shape bug). X219 PASSED splitter — main has had multiple splitter fixes since Phase 1. So 'sonnet-detecting' as a category is now testable; the result is invalid_submission, not splitter failure.

scope: Single Phase 2 run. Conclusively refutes the cost-savings hypothesis for detecting via sonnet variants. Implies the schema gate on v3 text-classification is opus-only.

consolidated_findings_on_detecting.the_question_collapses_to: What is the cheapest mix of opus-on-N-roles + cheaper-on-rest that still produces a valid submission AND a medal? Phase 1 opus-everywhere $341.83 gold is the ONLY known working point. Need targeted opus-role experiments.
consolidated_findings_on_detecting.cost_savings_pessimism: If schema gate is opus-coder (which carries most of Phase 1 cost at $336/$342 = 98%), then routing cannot reduce cost by more than ~$6 from the Phase 1 baseline. The cost-savings potential on detecting is much smaller than expected.

limitations: Opus-on-subset experiments not yet run. The schema gate might be a single opus role (designer, coder, or aggregator), in which case lifting only that one to opus + the rest sonnet would be the new cost minimum.
confidence: high (5 consecutive sonnet-or-haiku failures on the same task, identical failure mode)

implications.queue_revision: DEPRIORITIZE all sonnet-only-variant experiments on detecting (X220-style pairwise). They are highly likely to fail by inheritance from X219. INSTEAD: probe which OPUS role(s) cross the schema gate.
new_experiment_candidates: X230: opus-coder-only + sonnet-rest on detecting (X208 already queued covers this; promote to high)
X233: opus on {designer + aggregator} + sonnet-rest (cheapest two-opus minimum if either alone fails)

next_actions: Append X230-X233 to queue_v3.jsonl with priority=high.
Continue to next non-detecting experiment if no opus-on-detecting candidates take priority — X211/X212/X213 (denoising confirmation/variants) are next-best.
